KPI card — HTML · React · FreeMarker · Thymeleaf 
<article class="card kpi">
  <small>Revenue</small>
  <b>$48,290</b>
  <span data-chart="sparkline" data-values="[12,18,14,22,19,27,31]" aria-label="Revenue trend"></span>
  <span class="delta"><span class="up">▲ 12.4%</span> vs last month</span>
</article>
import { Sparkline } from "./charts-react";
export function Kpi({ label, value, trend, delta, up = true }) {
  return (
    <article className="card kpi">
      <small>{label}</small>
      <b>{value}</b>
      <Sparkline values={trend} label={`${label} trend`} />
      <span className="delta"><span className={up ? "up" : "down"}>{up ? "▲" : "▼"} {delta}</span> vs last month</span>
    </article>
  );
}
<Kpi label="Revenue" value="$48,290" trend={[12,18,14,22,19,27,31]} delta="12.4%" />
<#macro kpi label value trend delta up=true>
  <article class="card kpi">
    <small>${label}</small>
    <b>${value}</b>
    <span data-chart="sparkline" data-values="[${trend?join(",")}]" aria-label="${label} trend"></span>
    <span class="delta"><span class="${up?then('up','down')}">${up?then('▲','▼')} ${delta}</span> vs last month</span>
  </article>
</#macro>
<@kpi label="Revenue" value="$48,290" trend=[12,18,14,22,19,27,31] delta="12.4%"/>
<!-- Application template: values come from the controller model.
Install colibri-templates.jar or copy thymeleaf/ into templates/colibri/thymeleaf/. -->
<div th:replace="~{colibri/thymeleaf/kpi :: kpi('Revenue', ${revenue}, ${delta}, ${up})}"></div>

<!-- Library fragment (already supplied; shown for reference): -->
<article xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" th:fragment="kpi(label, value, delta, up)" class="card kpi">
  <small th:text="${label}">Revenue</small><b th:text="${value}">$0</b>
  <p class="delta">
    <span th:class="${up ? 'up' : 'down'}" th:text="${delta}">0%</span>vs last month
  </p>
</article>
Data table — HTML · React · FreeMarker · Thymeleaf 
<table class="data">
  <thead><tr><th>Customer</th><th>Plan</th><th>MRR</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td><span class="who"><span class="av">NK</span>Nino K.</span></td><td>Pro</td><td>$290</td>
        <td><span class="badge" data-tone="ok">Active</span></td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
export function CustomerTable({ rows }) {
  return (
    <table className="data">
      <thead><tr><th>Customer</th><th>Plan</th><th>MRR</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>{rows.map((c) => (
        <tr key={c.id}><td><span className="who"><span className="av">{c.initials}</span>{c.name}</span></td>
          <td>{c.plan}</td><td>{c.mrr}</td>
          <td><span className="badge" data-tone={c.active ? "ok" : "warn"}>{c.status}</span></td></tr>
      ))}</tbody>
    </table>
  );
}
<table class="data">
  <thead><tr><th>Customer</th><th>Plan</th><th>MRR</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
  <#list customers as c>
    <tr><td><span class="who"><span class="av">${c.initials}</span>${c.name}</span></td>
        <td>${c.plan}</td><td>${c.mrr?string.currency}</td>
        <td><span class="badge" data-tone="${c.active?then('ok','warn')}">${c.status}</span></td></tr>
  </#list>
  </tbody>
</table>
<!-- Application template: values come from the controller model.
Install colibri-templates.jar or copy thymeleaf/ into templates/colibri/thymeleaf/. -->
<div th:replace="~{colibri/thymeleaf/customer-table :: customer_table(${customers})}"></div>

<!-- Library fragment (already supplied; shown for reference): -->
<table xmlns:th="http://www.thymeleaf.org" th:fragment="customer_table(customers)" class="data">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th scope="col">Customer</th>
      <th scope="col">Plan</th>
      <th scope="col">MRR</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr th:each="customer : ${customers}">
      <td th:text="${customer.name}">Name</td>
      <td th:text="${customer.plan}">Plan</td>
      <td th:text="${customer.mrr}">0</td>
    </tr>
    <tr th:if="${#lists.isEmpty(customers)}">
      <td colspan="3">No customers yet</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
